stage_progress.title: Edge delivery and cache policy baseline
goals: classify public routes and assets by cacheability, freshness, invalidation and bypass requirements
map Stage 24 latency and cache evidence to measurable thresholds for edge/CDN investigation
define a provider-neutral edge delivery profile that preserves direct Caddy delivery as a supported fallback

stage_progress.title: Database connection and read scaling
goals: classify read paths eligible for connection pooling, Hyperdrive-equivalent acceleration or replicas
define consistency and failback rules that keep PostgreSQL primary authoritative
require connection saturation or query-latency evidence before promoting connection or replica infrastructure

stage_progress.title: Regional resilience and traffic control
goals: evaluate multi-instance delivery, load balancing, regional placement and circuit breaking against measured evidence
define health, drain, retry and failover semantics before routing automation
keep Envoy deferred until an explicit multi-service, gRPC, mTLS, multi-region or traffic-control trigger exists

stage_progress.title: External APM evaluation and stage closure
goals: evaluate external APM only against demonstrated Stage 24/25 observability gaps
record privacy, retention, operational cost and fallback behavior for any adoption decision
close Stage 25 through existing exact-head and canonical verification ownership

work_lease.authority: live Git branch + GitHub pull request
work_lease.rule: Never store volatile PR/head state as authored progress. AI must resolve the live branch/PR before writing; an existing active PR for the same semantic owner is resumed instead of duplicated. Stage work uses one umbrella branch while logical tranche ownership remains explicit in this plan.
